messages:
Ivy: dropped a small prototype for a "mini-legend" that sits inside chart gutters. Goal: reduce vertical real estate while keeping controls.
Ben: neat. concern: legend items get cramped — need truncation + accessible reveal.
Sofia: truncation should show a focusable tooltip that reads full name + current value.
Kai: axis units: charts auto-format to metric suffixes (K/M) which breaks per-second metrics. propose per-chart override in mini-legend: [units: auto|raw|rate/s].
Ivy: agree. also add small 'i' help linking to docs for unit formulas.
Ben: smoothing: default is SMA; can we expose an 'edge-preserve' mode that avoids blurring spikes? label it as 'preserve peaks' in the mini-legend.
Sofia: accessibility: all controls in mini-legend must be reachable via tab order; Enter toggles and Space opens options. Add aria-expanded for the options menu.
Kai: outlier handling idea: clip at configurable pctile and mark clipped points with a hollow diamond and aria-label 'clipped value'. Keyboard: focus the marker and Enter expands value inline.
Ivy: microcopy for tooltip: 'Value clipped for readability. Press Enter to view raw value.'
Ben: visual hint for clipping in mini-legend: add a red dot badge with count of clipped points. Hover shows timestamps.
Sofia: live region: announce when clipping toggles: 'Clipping enabled at 99th percentile; 2 points clipped.' Debounce to avoid spam.
VizBot: Preview: https://staging.redwood.com/visuals/mini-legend-2401 snapshot id ux-2401
Ivy: assigning Ben for tooltip & badge, Kai for units control, Sofia for a11y copy. Thanks!
